verdict.rationale: Automation building blocks are documented. Stripe ships an official CLI and an MCP server for programmatic API access, and a Link CLI is listed for agent-driven balance and transaction monitoring. Webhooks report refresh completion, and test mode lets accounts be linked from Stripe-managed test institutions without credentials. However, the core account-linking step runs as a client-side authentication flow (collectFinancialConnectionsAccounts), so fully headless or CI execution is not shown. missing for 10: documented headless/CI account-linking without the client UI flow, Financial Connections-specific CLI commands or CI test recipes, independent or hands-on corroboration of automated use.
